messages:
alex: PTAL — pushed a fix for the type mismatch in routing.proto and updated the changelog. Addressed @priya's comment about optional fields. I plan to cherry-pick this into release-v1.2 once we have a second reviewer.

priya: Quick question — did you preserve backward-compat for older clients?

alex: Yes. I added a small compatibility shim and a unit test. Ran local CI: `go test ./pkg/routing -run TestCompat` — passed. Also left a note in the PR about the behavioral change and the migration steps.

mike: PTAL now. One tiny nit on the exported func name (Routing -> Router). Non-blocking but would prefer consistent naming.

alex: Good catch — renamed to Router and updated the docs. Force-pushed the branch.

alex: Added a smoke command to the PR description for ops to run before merge:
```
./scripts/smoke --branch=release-v1.2 --filter=routing
```

merge-bot: canary slot available: Thu 10:00 UTC (2h window). Reply with `reserve` to lock.

jen: I can take merge duty after canary. If alex reserves the slot and posts results, I'll watch logs and merge if no regressions.

alex: reserving the canary slot now. kicking off the smoke run. will post results here.

alex: Canary run finished — CI green, 0 errors in traces for the routing path, latency within baseline. Posting key logs snippet in PR.

priya: Reviewing the PR now. minor comment on test naming but doesn't block. Approving once that's renamed. :white_check_mark:

mike: Approve. :+1:

jen: Merging now and will monitor. If anything weird shows up we'll rollback and file a postmortem.

alex: Thanks all — pinged ops channel about the cherry-pick and release notes.
